sourcesContent: import { ModalOverlay, ModalContent, ModalImage, ModalDetails, ModalTitle, ModalDescription, ModalButton, CloseButton } from './styles' type ModalProps = { isOpen: boolean onClose: () => void image: string title: string description: string } const Modal = ({ isOpen, onClose, image, title, description }: ModalProps) => { if (!isOpen) return null // Não renderiza o modal se não estiver aberto return ( {title} {description} Fechar ) } export default Modal
